newsitem.title: USA: Medical Manager Corp Q1 net increases. [CORRECTED 09:00 GMT 26/4]
newsitem.headline: Medical Manager Corp Q1 net increases. [CORRECTED 09:00 GMT 26/4]

text.p: Three months ended Three months ended
NOTE: The company said pro forma results include the company's mergers and IPO as if they closed on February 4, 1997. (Corrects to remove the companies involved in the merger).

Actual results include the acquiring founding company's statement of operations for the period from January 1, 1997 through March 31, 1997 and each other founding company's statements of operations for the period of February 5, 1997 through March 31, 1997.

The difference between the actual tax provision of $576,000 and that obtained by multiplying income before income taxes by the applicable federal tax rate of 34% is attributable to the acquiring founding company's status as an S-corporation for the month of January 1997 and therefore not being subject to income taxes, the one-time benefit of approximately $350,000 related to the establishment of deferred taxes upon the termination of the acquiring founding four company's S-corporation status and state income taxes.
